messages.author: f20966e9bc9cf5c7
messages.subject: stat_smooth formula specification
parts:
Dear ggplot gurus,

I'm starting to integrate more ggplot code into my work, because the
little fiddly things are starting to annoy me as well. I'm confused
about the following specification of the formula for stat_smooth:

d.f2 <- data.frame(ab=1:100/100, ab2=1:100, direction=sample(c("black",
"white"),
100, TRUE),
breed=sample(c("blue",
"red"), 100, TRUE))
d.f3 <- subset(d.f2, !(direction == "black" & breed == "blue"))
ggplot() + facet_grid(breed ~ .) +
geom_point(data=d.f2, aes(ab, ab2, color=direction)) +
stat_smooth(data=d.f3, mapping = aes(x=ab, y=ab2), method="lm",
level=0.95, formula=ab2 ~ 0 + ab)

As you can see, I want to force the regression line through the origin
(although in my example it's obviously going to go through zero) in each
of the facets. In the second facet, I would like the regression line to
only go through a certain set of points.

Without the formula specification the code works fine. The plot also
looks very good and it's almost good enough. I greatly appreciate the help.

Cheers,
Brian

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: stat_smooth formula specification
parts:
Try referring to the variables in the formula by their "argument name".

formula = y ~ 0 + x

Cheers,
Roman
